name: Integrated isolated bias module (+15/-4 V) with optional sensing supply
function: Provides +15 V / -4 V isolated rails per gate driver from 12 V with an integrated-transformer module; the low-side module optionally also feeds a 5 V LDO for isolated sensing.

outputs.name: 5V_ISO
outputs.description: optional LDO output for isolated amplifiers/modulators

operating_conditions: 1.5 W per module at 10.8-13.2 V input (datasheet).

design_calculations.name: Bias power budget
design_calculations.expression: P_total = Q_G * f_sw * (VDD - VEE) + P_quiescent + P_shared_loads <= module rating
design_calculations.example: C3M0075120K: 53 nC * 100 kHz * 19 V = 0.10 W (TI's Eq.30 doubles this)

interface_requirements: Shared sensing supply only for sensors referenced to the same node as that switch's source.
pcb_constraints: Module placed beside its driver on the same isolated island; no copper crossing the barrier.
LED indicator per output (TI) is optional.
validation_notes: Values taken from TI's figures and BOM; the module's feedback-resistor equations were not recomputed because they are datasheet-specific and not published in the design guide.
limitations: TI provided but did not test bias sharing between low-side FETs or bootstrap options (§3.4.2).
